intro.title: Air Pulse
intro.body: Explore hourly observations and the supplied forecast snapshot for four Mumbai stations. This view is not live monitoring and does not infer freshness from your device clock.
dashboard.errorTitle: Air data could not be loaded
station.heading: Mumbai stations
station.locatorTitle: Schematic locator for the four Mumbai air stations
station.locatorDescription: Station positions are plotted from the supplied latitude and longitude coordinates. Use the station selector above to change the selected location.
station.locatorCaption: Schematic locator, not a street map. Station positions use the coordinates in the supplied station reference.
outlook.heading: Air outlook
outlook.loading: Loading observations and forecast from the fixed snapshot…
metric.noTrend: Not enough complete hourly forecast points to estimate a trend
chart.title: Hourly PM2.5
chart.description: Observed and forecast intervals remain separate. Missing or excluded intervals appear as gaps.
chart.svgDescription: The chart separates observations from forecast intervals and preserves gaps. Source-flagged observations are listed in the data table but excluded from the plotted summary.
chart.caption: Values are hourly PM2.5 concentrations. Thresholds follow the configured visualization bands and are not medical advice.
chart.empty: No complete hourly values are available to plot for this station.
chart.flaggedCount: {count} source-flagged observation(s) are retained below for diagnosis and excluded from the plotted summary.
chart.tableCaption: Hourly observations and forecast values for {station}. Times are shown in India Standard Time.
chart.flagged: Flagged; excluded from the plotted summary
planner.heading: Find a lower-exposure time
planner.description: The local Go service compares complete contiguous forecast windows. A preferred-time comparison is optional.
planner.capability: Forecast calculations use Go · explanations require an explicit request
form.activityHelp: Choose the activity you are planning.
form.dateHelp: Dates outside the supplied forecast coverage will be rejected.
form.latestHelp: 24:00 means midnight at the end of the selected date.
form.durationHelp: Plans use complete hourly forecast coverage.
form.preferredHelp: When set, the response also compares this time with the recommendation.
form.note: Planning uses the selected station and the fixed forecast snapshot only.
validation.required: Choose a value for this field.
validation.range: Choose a value within the available range.
validation.formError: Please correct the highlighted fields before creating an activity plan.
plan.title: Suggested activity period
plan.comparisonValue: Preferred mean forecast PM2.5: {mean}. Recommended mean minus preferred mean: {difference} µg/m³.
plan.disclaimer: This is a relative comparison of forecast values, not a health guarantee or medical advice. Forecast generation time is unavailable.
plan.explanationHelp: An explanation is requested only when you activate this button. If Gemma is unavailable or times out, a deterministic template is returned; the Go-computed values do not change.
plan.modeGemma: Gemma-generated; validated against the fixed evidence
plan.explanationGemmaReady: A validated Gemma explanation is ready.
plan.explanationTemplateReady: A deterministic template explanation is ready.
plan.createProgress: Creating an activity plan from the selected forecast snapshot.
plan.createError: Activity plan could not be created. {error}
plan.explanationProgress: Requesting an explanation for the displayed plan.
plan.noSavedPlan: New activity planning requires the local Air Guardian service. Previously saved plans remain available. No exact saved plan matches these inputs and the selected forecast snapshot.
plan.noSavedExplanation: The local service is unavailable and no saved explanation matches this exact plan and forecast snapshot.
plan.savedAt: Showing the saved plan from {time}. No new calculation was made.
plan.explanationSavedAt: Showing the saved explanation from {time}; it was not regenerated.
plan.explanationGemma: Gemma-generated; validated against the fixed evidence
beacon.heading: Air Beacon preview
beacon.description: Preview a light pattern derived from the selected station's highest forecast interval. No hardware or serial port is used; this is not a sensor or medical advice.
beacon.steadyHelp: This affects only the preview. The color marker stays static; text describes the selected pattern.
beacon.resultNote: Simulated only — Air Guardian does not control a physical device.
beacon.diagnosticNote: This diagnostic changes only the preview; it does not alter or validate air data.
source.eyebrow: What is and is not connected
source.heading: Sources and capability status
source.description: All air values come from the supplied, locally validated files. Forecast issuance time is not present in the input data; the snapshot must not be interpreted as a live feed.
source.noExtraScaling: No additional scaling is applied in this interface.
source.capabilityNote: Weather context is not implemented or validated. Beacon output is a virtual simulation only; no physical control is connected. AI explanations are available only after an explicit request; local Gemma availability is reported separately, with a deterministic fallback when generation is unavailable.
footer.info: Informational tool only · Not medical advice
